height_definition: camera-stabilized torso midpoint clearance / pre-kick body height

reference.definition: observed pre-contact ankle line parallel to visible goal baseline
reference.body_scale_reference: confident upright preparation only, not crouched or sideways bbox height
reference.assumption: keeper stays approximately at the reference depth

pose_only_phase.height_definition: maximum three-sample median torso-center ground clearance / pre-kick body height

observed_image_plane_signal.definition: maximum three-sample median observed torso midpoint clearance from the pre-contact image reference line, normalized by preparation body height
observed_image_plane_signal.lower_bound_scope: sampled image-plane signal in the connected observed first extension; not physical height
observed_image_plane_signal.fixed_reference_depth_assumption: keeper stays approximately at the reference depth
